payload.note: Repaired one-bubble family compactness checkpoint: for Omega_m=1/(m+F4), the quotient Q(m)=||E_m||^2/||R_m||^2 extends positively to t=m/(1+m) in [0,1]. At m down to zero, E_m converges strongly in L2 to a finite nonzero E0 while ||R_m||^2 tends to 32 pi^2/3+||R0||^2; q0(pi,0,0,0)=-128/9 proves E0 is nonzero. At infinity Q tends exactly to 32/17. For finite m, E=0 would force q constant, then Delta Omega=c Omega^3, c=0, and Omega constant, excluding this family. Hence some c_F4>0 bounds Q over the full repaired one-parameter family, though its value and any all-field bound remain open. Single repaired sphere-bubble collapse is ruled out; multi-bubble/profile decomposition, Witten, interacting H^-1, continuum, Born, Krein, and Lorentzian gates remain open.
